card.name: Possessives and determiners before a noun
card.fires_on: Small determiner-like words such as its, their, thy, the, and Mr that sit right before a noun phrase, in general prose. The next word is often a noun like name, seed, eggs, or population.

modes.label: Possessive pronouns
modes.description: Its, their, or thy right before a noun that belongs to the subject.
modes.example: Cobalt derived<< its>> name from German miners.

modes.label: Other determiners
modes.description: The or similar words starting a noun phrase after a verb or clause.

modes.label: Title before a name
modes.description: The title Mr before a surname at the start of a clause.
modes.example: based on<< Mr>>. Johntz's hunch that

card.writes: It pushes a few unrelated tokens, mostly Chinese words and word pieces, with no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires on little words like its, their, or the that come just before a noun.
